dogecoin.text:
Whilst digital payments and blockchain technology may have a sustainable future, a currency created as a joke commanding a $2 billion value, says everything about the current mispricing of risk.
BBC News - Forget Bitcoin - now Dogecoin goes wild https://t.co/NP7cjiTkNq

Dogecoin has fallen by 65 per cent since my tweet eight days ago.
Maybe value investing, rather than momentum investing ( buy it because it has gone up) will make a long overdue comeback . 
Last week a US ETF MTUM, which buys stocks because they go up, received $500m- ludicrous.
